key_insight: An LLM-based agent evolves programs that generate fault-tolerant Clifford circuits, guided by a circuit verifier.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce manual circuit-design effort across logical state preparation, logical gates, and encoded-qubit routines.
method: Frame circuit discovery as agentic evolutionary program synthesis.
Use an LLM’s pretrained knowledge and tool use to evolve circuit-generating programs.
Guide synthesis with a verifier and exhaustively check faults.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports fault-tolerant circuits for all curated tasks, including code switching and code growth, with each circuit verified by exhaustive fault checks.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish scalability beyond curated tasks or specify the fault model and computational cost of exhaustive verification.
paper_title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
